limits: One 39-token prompt / 64 output tokens. Four warmups, five timed repeats. Sequential groups on separate binaries; final 16 then 0 uses one binary. No universal optimum claim.
First request after model loading was slower with slabs in the final comparison. The speed improvement is for warm decoding; OS file cache was not cleared and cold SSD startup was not isolated.

RAM/VRAM 95% are global sampled targets. Other processes and sample lag can temporarily exceed them. Physical growth is checked before each new slab, with a 2 MiB margin; this is not an atomic reservation.
Source/H2D byte deltas include prefill and decode. Memory figures are post-request samples. Power consumption was not measured.

Long context, more prompts, Linux/HIP, real Qwen/DeepSeek and P4 session reuse were not tested in this round. MTP remains off in all real benchmarks and checks; pre-existing native MTP fixtures still pass.
